column1: # Spanish keywords for Mulberry Symbols — hand-curated list.
# STATUS: pending review by a credentialed SLP (speech-language pathologist /
# terapeuta de lenguaje). Do not present these keywords as clinically
# validated until that review is recorded here.
# Source: curated entry by entry for the AAC core and the most common fringe
# words, Mexican Spanish first. No upstream or third-party Spanish label set
# for Mulberry was available under a licence compatible with this repository
# (Global Symbols API, checked 2026-10-03: zero Spanish labels for the
# Mulberry set). This is not a bulk machine translation of the Mulberry set;
# words without an entry here are searchable in English (and French) only.
# The first keyword is the primary label. Lines starting with # are comments.
# Rebuild the index after editing: node packages/symbols/scripts/build-mulberry-index.mjs <mulberry-checkout>
